96	interface QueueAddResult {

101	}

103	let _queue: QueueInstance | null = null
104	let _queueInitFailed = false

106	async function getQueue(): Promise<QueueInstance | null> {
107	  if (_queueInitFailed) return null
108	  if (_queue) return _queue
109	
110	  const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL
111	  if (!redisUrl) {
112	    return null
113	  }
114	
115	  try {
116	    // Dynamic import so the web app bundle never includes BullMQ
117	    // The `as string` cast avoids static analysis bundling it
118	    const bullmq = await import('bullmq' as string) as { Queue: new (name: string, opts: unknown) => QueueInstance }
119	    _queue = new bullmq.Queue(QUEUE_NAME, {
120	      connection: {
121	        url: redisUrl,
122	        maxRetriesPerRequest: null,  // required for BullMQ ioredis compatibility
123	      },
124	      defaultJobOptions: {
125	        attempts: 3,
126	        backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 5_000 },
127	        removeOnComplete: 100,
128	        removeOnFail: 500,
129	      },
130	    })
131	    return _queue
132	  } catch (err) {
133	    _queueInitFailed = true
134	    logger.error({ err }, 'queue: failed to initialize BullMQ — jobs will be dropped')
135	    return null
136	  }
137	}

141	export async function enqueueJob<T extends JobName>(
142	  jobName: T,
143	  payload: JobPayloadMap[T],
144	  opts?: { delay?: number; priority?: number },
145	): Promise<{ id: string }> {
146	  const queue = await getQueue()
147	
148	  if (!queue) {
149	    logger.warn(
150	      { jobName },
151	      'queue: REDIS_URL not set or queue unavailable — job dropped (set REDIS_URL in .env.local for full functionality)',
152	    )
153	    return { id: `noop-${Date.now()}` }
154	  }
155	
156	  try {
157	    const job = await queue.add(jobName, payload, {
158	      ...(opts?.delay !== undefined && { delay: opts.delay }),
159	      ...(opts?.priority !== undefined && { priority: opts.priority }),
160	    })
161	    logger.info({ jobName, jobId: job.id }, 'queue: job enqueued')
162	    return { id: job.id ?? `queued-${Date.now()}` }
163	  } catch (err) {
164	    logger.error({ err, jobName }, 'queue: failed to enqueue job')
165	    throw err

35	 *

43	export async function sendClientMessageAction(input: SendMessageInput): Promise<SendMessageResult> {
44	  // ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
45	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
46	  if (!auth) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' }
47	
48	  // ── Validate input ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
49	  const parsed = SendMessageSchema.safeParse(input)
50	  if (!parsed.success) {
51	    const first = parsed.error.issues[0]
52	    return { ok: false, error: first?.message ?? 'Validation failed' }
53	  }
54	
55	  const { clientId, channel, body, templateKey } = parsed.data
56	  const subject = parsed.data.subject ?? ''
57	
58	  // ── Rate limit (per studio) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
59	  const { success } = await expensiveRatelimit.limit(auth.studioId)
60	  if (!success) return { ok: false, error: 'rate_limit' }
61

64

66	    const { data: client, error: clientErr } = await supabase
67	      .from('clients')

69	      .eq('id', clientId)
70	      .eq('studio_id', auth.studioId)
71	      .single()

75	    }

78	      return { ok: false, error: 'Cannot message banned clients' }
79	    }

94	        },

9	const ExportSchema = z.object({

17	function toIcsDate(d: Date): string {
18	  return d.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace(/\.\d{3}/, '')
19	}
20	
21	function escapeIcsText(text: string): string {
22	  return text
23	    .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
24	    .replace(/;/g, '\\;')
25	    .replace(/,/g, '\\,')
26	    .replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
27	}
28	
29	function foldLine(line: string): string {
30	  if (line.length <= 75) return line
31	  const parts: string[] = []
32	  let idx = 0
33	  while (idx < line.length) {
34	    parts.push(line.slice(idx, idx + 75))
35	    idx += 75
36	  }
37	  return parts.join('\r\n ')
38	}

40	interface BookingRow {
41	  id: string
42	  scheduled_at: string
43	  end_at: string
44	  status: string
45	  notes: string | null
46	  created_at: string
47	  client: { first_name: string; last_name: string | null; email: string | null } | null
48	  artist: { display_name: string } | null
49	  service: { name: string } | null
50	}
51	
52	function buildVEvent(booking: BookingRow, studioName: string): string {
53	  const start = new Date(booking.scheduled_at)
54	  const end = new Date(booking.end_at)
55	  const clientName = booking.client
56	    ? `${booking.client.first_name} ${booking.client.last_name ?? ''}`.trim()
57	    : 'Unknown Client'
58	  const summary = [
59	    booking.service?.name ?? 'Appointment',
60	    clientName,
61	  ].join(' — ')
62	  const description = [
63	    `Artist: ${booking.artist?.display_name ?? 'Unassigned'}`,
64	    `Status: ${booking.status}`,
65	    booking.client?.email ? `Client email: ${booking.client.email}` : null,
66	    booking.notes ? `Notes: ${booking.notes}` : null,
67	  ]
68	    .filter(Boolean)
69	    .join('\\n')
70	
71	  const lines = [
72	    'BEGIN:VEVENT',
73	    foldLine(`UID:${booking.id}@inkos.app`),
74	    foldLine(`DTSTAMP:${toIcsDate(new Date(booking.created_at))}`),
75	    foldLine(`DTSTART:${toIcsDate(start)}`),
76	    foldLine(`DTEND:${toIcsDate(end)}`),
77	    foldLine(`SUMMARY:${escapeIcsText(summary)}`),
78	    foldLine(`DESCRIPTION:${escapeIcsText(description)}`),
79	    foldLine(`ORGANIZER;CN=${escapeIcsText(studioName)}:mailto:noreply@inkos.app`),
80	    'END:VEVENT',
81	  ]
82	
83	  return lines.join('\r\n')
84	}

86	export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
87	  const authUser = await getAuthenticatedUser()
88	  if (!authUser) {
89	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
90	  }
91	
92	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(authUser.user.id)
93	  if (!success) {
94	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests' }, { status: 429 })
95	  }
96	
97	  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
98	  const parsed = ExportSchema.safeParse(Object.fromEntries(searchParams))
99	  if (!parsed.success) {
100	    return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
101	  }
102	
103	  const { start, end } = parsed.data
104	  // studioId from parsed.data is verified against authUser.studioId below —
105	  // always use the authenticated studio, ignore any passed studioId param
106	  const studioId = authUser.studioId
107	
108	  try {
109	    const supabase = await createClient()
110	
111	    // Fetch studio name for ORGANIZER
112	    const { data: studio } = await supabase
113	      .from('studios')
114	      .select('name')
115	      .eq('id', studioId)
116	      .single()
117	
118	    const studioName = studio?.name ?? 'InkOS Studio'
119	
120	    let query = supabase
121	      .from('bookings')
122	      .select(
123	        `id, scheduled_at, end_at, status, notes, created_at,
124	         client:clients(first_name, last_name, email),
125	         artist:artists(display_name),
126	         service:services(name)`
127	      )
128	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
129	      .not('status', 'in', '("cancelled","no_show")')
130	      .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: true })
131	
132	    if (start) query = query.gte('scheduled_at', start)
133	    if (end) query = query.lte('scheduled_at', end)
134	
135	    const { data, error: dbError } = await query
136	
137	    if (dbError) {
138	      logger.error({ err: dbError }, 'calendar export db error')
139	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Database error' }, { status: 500 })
140	    }
141	
142	    const bookings = (data ?? []) as unknown as BookingRow[]
143	
144	    const vEvents = bookings.map((b) => buildVEvent(b, studioName)).join('\r\n')
145	
146	    const ics = [
147	      'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
148	      'VERSION:2.0',
149	      'PRODID:-//InkOS//InkOS Calendar//EN',
150	      'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
151	      'METHOD:PUBLISH',
152	      foldLine(`X-WR-CALNAME:${escapeIcsText(studioName)}`),
153	      'X-WR-TIMEZONE:UTC',
154	      vEvents,
155	      'END:VCALENDAR',
156	    ].join('\r\n')
157	
158	    const filename = start
159	      ? `inkos-calendar-${start.slice(0, 10)}.ics`
160	      : 'inkos-calendar.ics'
161	
162	    return new NextResponse(ics, {
163	      status: 200,
164	      headers: {
165	        'Content-Type': 'text/calendar; charset=utf-8',
166	        'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
167	        'Cache-Control': 'private, no-cache',
168	      },
169	    })
170	  } catch (err) {
171	    logger.error({ err }, 'calendar export failed')
172	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
173	  }
174	}
